python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import json
import subprocess

repo='repos/organvm-iii-ergon/collaboration-operations-platform'

meta = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', repo], text=True))
assert meta.get('private') is True
assert meta.get('default_branch') == 'main'

for file in ['AGENTS.md', 'CONTRIBUTING.md', 'SECURITY.md', 'CODEOWNERS', '.github/CODEOWNERS']:
    payload = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/{file}'], text=True))
    text = base64.b64decode(payload['content']).decode('utf-8') if payload.get('encoding') == 'base64' else ''
    if file.endswith('CODEOWNERS'):
        assert '* @organvm-iii-ergon/owners' in text

outside = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/collaborators?affiliation=outside&per_page=100'], text=True))
assert outside == []

latest = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/commits/main'], text=True))
assert latest['commit']['message'].startswith('chore: add root CODEOWNERS for governance')
print('PASS: governance files present and constraints captured; outside collaborators none; commit', latest['sha'][:8])
PY
